author: bigfnj
name: DesktopPet plugin module
description: A DesktopPet plugin module: an IModule against DesktopPet.Contracts, wired to ModuleKit, with a tray item, a settings pane and a self-test.

moduleId.description: The module's id: lowercase, no spaces. It names the output folder (modules/<id>/), the settings/storage key, the self-test flag (--<id>-selftest) and the catalog entry. Hard to change later, so pick it deliberately.

displayName.description: The name shown in the Modules pane and the settings pane title.

minHostVersion.description: The oldest host this module runs on. Raise it only when you actually call a newer ABI member: a module declaring a version above the shipped host is refused forever.
